meaning.vi: con sâu bướm, xe dây xích
meaning.en: A caterpillar is a small insect that looks like a worm and eats plants.

examples.en: After eating a lot of leaves, caterpillars change into butterflies.

meaning.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture that is used to store food or household items.

examples.en: We put all of our dishes and food in the cupboards.

meaning.vi: mỏng manh, dễ vỡ (đồ thuỷ tinh...)
meaning.en: Delicate things are easy to break or harm.

examples.en: You should hold the baby carefully because she’s very delicate.

meaning.vi: nổi lên, hiện ra, lòi ra, trồi lên
meaning.en: To emerge from something means to come out of it.

examples.en: A groundhog emerged from a snow covered hole.

meaning.vi: tật nguyền, kém năng lực, thiểu năng
meaning.en: A handicap is a condition that limits someone’s mental or physical abilities.

examples.en: Joe has a slight handicap, so he uses a walker to get around.

meaning.en: A hole is a hollow space in something solid.

examples.en: They made a big hole in the wall.

meaning.vi: cái lưỡi câu, cái móc, cái liềm
meaning.en: A hook is a sharp curved piece of metal used for catching or holding things.

examples.en: The fish went after the sharp hook.

meaning.vi: nhảy lò cò, nhảy bước ngắn, nhảy qua hố
meaning.en: To hop means to jump a short distance.

examples.en: The kangaroo quickly hopped away from danger.

meaning.vi: hiệu giặt là; quần áo đã giặt xong hoặc quần áo đưa đi giặt
meaning.en: Laundry is clothes that have been or need to be washed.

examples.en: He folded the clean laundry and put the dirty laundry in a basket.

meaning.en: To pursue is to chase or follow someone or something.

examples.en: The mother pursued her young child down the hill.

meaning.en: Reluctant means not wanting to do something.

examples.en: She was reluctant to say that she saw the robbery.

meaning.en: Sleeves are the part of a shirt in which arms go.

examples.en: Ryan bought a new shirt with long sleeves to keep his arms warm.

meaning.en: The spine is the group of bones that run up and down the middle of the back.

examples.en: Our spine helps us to stand up nice and straight.

meaning.en: A stain is a dirty mark that is difficult to clean.

examples.en: He had a red stain on the collar of his shirt.

meaning.en: A strip is a long, narrow piece of material or land.

examples.en: He had long strips of film that held images of his trip abroad.

meaning.en: To swear means to promise to do something.

examples.en: I will put my hand on the Bible and swear to do my best for the country.

meaning.vi: đánh đu, ngoặt (xe, tàu...), vung vẩy, lắc
meaning.en: To swing something means to move it back and forth or from side to side.

examples.en: He can swing a golf club very powerfully.
